description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for health checks in the Ditto project, including methods to check if health checking is enabled and to retrieve the interval duration between checks. It also includes an enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: HealthCheckConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default values for the health check configuration, including settings for enabling health checks and their interval durations.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether global health checking is enabled.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration for health checks.
